description: This file contains an example implementation of Alternating Least Squares (ALS) algorithm using PySpark and NumPy, demonstrating how to perform collaborative filtering for recommendations.

methods.name: rmse
methods.description: Calculates the root mean squared error between the actual ratings matrix R and the predicted ratings ms * us.T.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Performs an update step for a user or item feature vector in the ALS algorithm.
